p: To put himself and others in mind of God's chastisement for sin.
wrath: He desires not to be exempted from God's rod, but that he would so moderate his hand, that he might be able to bear it.
arrows stick fast in me: Your sickness, with which you have visited me.
sin: David acknowledges God to be just in his punishments, because his sins had deserved much more.
iniquities are gone over mine head: He confesses his sins, God's justice, and makes prayer his refuge.
my foolishness: That rather gave place to my own lusts, than to the will of God.
have roared by reason of the: This example warns us never to despair, no matter how great the torment: but always to cry to God with sure trust for deliverance.
it also is gone from me: My sight fails me for sorrow.
kinsmen stand afar off: Partly for fear and partly for pride, they denied all duty and friendship.
deaf man: For I can have no audience before men, and therefore patiently wait for the help of God.
when my foot slippeth: That is, if they see that you do not help me in time, they will mock and triumph as though you had forsaken me.
halt: I am without hope to recover my strength.
enemies are lively: In my greatest misery they most rejoice.
good is: He would rather have the hatred of all the world, than fail in any part of his duty to God.
salvation: Who is the author of my salvation: and this declares that he prayed with sure hope of deliverance.
